subject: Edgesync call digest: SDK streaming, funcall & embedding fit
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@edgesync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Edgesync call digest: SDK streaming, funcall & embedding fit

Laura — thanks for the time today. Quick digest from our side with concrete asks and a proposed pilot outline so we can move to a technical kickoff next week.

TL;DR (top priorities you called out)
- Low-latency streaming for on-device assistants (partial tokens matter)
- Deterministic structured outputs for telemetry ingestion (JSON schema)
- Embedding-based search + rerank for device logs (offline indexing + online rerank)
- Secure private deployment (VPC + KMS) for PII-containing telemetry

Pain & constraints you mentioned
- Peak concurrency from regional edge gateways is bursty (hundreds of concurrent small requests).
- Max tail latency target: 150ms p95 for partial streaming responses.
- Budget sensitivity: trying to keep unit token costs predictable for pilot scale.
- Security: SOC-2 evidence and an IP-protected network path for PII flows.

Where Redwood maps to those needs (short)
- Streaming + partial token delivery: runtime supports streaming with incremental function-calls to let devices act on partial outputs.
- Structured outputs: function-calling + schema validation to emit deterministic JSON and reduce post-processing on your side.
- Embeddings & rerank: hybrid approach — batch offline embedding index + real-time rerank to keep tail latency low.
- Private deployment options: VPC/private control plane + KMS and audit logs.

Proposed 4-week pilot (minimal scope)
1) Week 0: Kickoff + security intake (we get your questionnaire; Tom to lead).
2) Week 1: SDK adapter + minimal endpoint (streaming enabled; function-call wrapper) — deliverable: small SDK change checklist and sample integration.
3) Week 2: Embed index for 50k records + rerank endpoint; perf smoke testing.
4) Week 3: Closed-loop test on device simulator; validate p95 streaming latency and JSON outputs.

Concrete asks from EdgeSync (what we need to start)
- Short security questionnaire (if you can send it today).
- Sample telemetry payloads + a representative query set (5–10 queries).
- A contact for infra (Tom or whoever owns VPC/workflows).

Deliverables we will share by EOD tomorrow
- "edgesync-sdk-change-checklist.pdf" (small diff and integration steps) — attached
- PoC proposal doc with timeline and success criteria — Doc link in related links

Suggested next steps (please confirm):
- Can we schedule a 45-minute technical kickoff next week (Wed/Thu preferred)?
- If Tom can join the kickoff, we can triage the security intake live.

Thanks again — I’ve looped in Kimberly (solutions) on cc and can add Ben (implementation lead) to the thread if you want him on the kickoff.

—
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Aditya — thanks for the concise digest and the checklist. Helpful.

Quick confirmations:
- We do need streaming partial tokens: our device UX will accept partial results and render progressively, so seeing early tokens matters.
- Deterministic JSON schema is non-negotiable for our telemetry pipeline (we can share the schema).
- Security: I’m looping Tom (infra) and security@edgesync to handle the intake. I’ll send the security questionnaire as soon as I have it (likely today).

Kickoff availability
- Wed 31 May 10:00–11:00 PDT or Thu 1 Jun 14:00–15:00 PDT — either works for us; prefer Wed.

One ask from our side before kickoff
- Can you highlight any non-trivial SDK changes you expect (surface-level bullets) so our SDK owners can estimate effort?

We’ll also provide:
- Sample telemetry payloads and a short query set by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — copying Tom and security.

—
Laura Chen
Head of Product, EdgeSync
laura.chen@edgesync.com | (617) 555-0199

Laura / Tom / security@edgesync — great, thanks for the quick reply and willingness to move to kickoff next week. I’ve confirmed Wed 2027-05-31 10:00 PDT for a 45-minute technical kickoff. Calendar invite will follow.

I answered your SDK-change ask briefly below so your SDK owners can do a quick estimate ahead of the kickoff: (these are intentionally minimal changes)
- Streaming: add an event handler for partial token frames (client-visible callback); server stream is standard chunked responses.
- Function-calling: lightweight wrapper to map structured funcall outputs into your connector interface (we’ll provide a sample).
- Structured JSON: Redwood can validate against your schema server-side; SDK will include a strict parser and a fallback validation error with mapping hints.
- Auth: short-lived token option + support for VPC endpoint; no major auth rework if you already use token-based flows.

Action items (agreed)
- EdgeSync: send security questionnaire + sample telemetry payloads (Laura/Tom) — target: Wed 05/26 EOD.
- Redwood: share PoC spec, integration checklist, and a minimal example repo (Aditya) — target: Wed 05/26 EOD.
- Schedule & invite: Aditya to send invite for Wed 05/31 10:00 PDT.

Ben (cc’d) will join kickoff as implementation lead; Kimberly will cover solution design and performance targets.

If anything changes, please reply here; otherwise expect the invite + docs from me shortly.

—
Aditya Rao
